{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Elite Void Rusher''' is a fast enemy that appear in both [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It is a stronger version of the [[Void Rusher]], having same speed and [[Defense]] but way higher health and [[Shield Health]]. Once its [[Shield Health]] is depleted, its shield will break causing it to become slower and losing all of its [[Defense]]. ==Logbook Description== "''The Elite Void Rusher’s shield is made out of a special material forged in the Void. It’s faster, heavier, and more armored than the Void Rusher. It will continue to charge forward regardless of its own safety to cut an opening for the army to seep into. They are fundamentally the most important fighters on the battlefield, and it’s best not to take them lightly. They are what punches the hold{{sic}} for the Void to flow through.''" ==Appearance== The '''Elite Void Rusher''' has a black body with purple lines going across it. It wears purple boots, chestplate, shoulder-pads and helmet, all with gold accents. It carries a purple and gold shield which is broken once all of its [[Shield Health]] is depleted. ==Strategy== *The '''Elite Void Rusher''' is essentially a much stronger version of the [[Void Rusher]], having much higher health and [[Shield Health]] while also maintaining the same speeds. This makes it more threatening than the [[Void Rusher]], as its high [[Shield Health]] can be much more difficult to deplete, allowing it to maintain its extremely swift speed. **DPS towers with higher upgrades such the [[Accelerator]], [[Juggernaut]], [[Kingpin]], [[Ranger]] and [[Golden Minigunner]] are beneficial to melting down its high [[Shield Health]] in order to slow it down. ***Support towers like the [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] or [[Medic]] can also aid in increasing the DPS of your towers. *Just like the [[Void Rusher]], towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Frost Blaster]], [[Sledger]] or [[Freezer]] can counter the '''Elite Void Rusher's''' extremely fast speed. **The [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Freezer]] can also decrease the high [[Defense]] of the '''Elite Void Rusher''', making it easier to kill it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Elite Void Rusher''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} EliteVoidRusherCA.jpg|''' Elite Void Rusher''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} EliteVoidRusherIconIG.png|'''Elite Void Rusher''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Elite Void Rusher''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Elite Void Rusher''' added. {{Hardcore|[[Void Brute]]|Wave 33|[[Unknown Small]] & Elite Void Rusher|Wave 34|[[Nightshade]]|Wave 35}} {{Voidcore|[[Unknown Small]]|Wave 36|Elite Void Rusher|Wave 37|[[Slow King]]|Wave 38}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
